main_text.head: CAPUT XIII. Hottingerana Disputationis Apologetica contra Allatium de consensu Græcæ Romanæque Ecclesiæ fordes, atque mendacia eluuntur.
main_text.p: DUm hæc Exercitationi extrema lineamenta adderem, & ad metam properaret oratio, en ecce ad me literæ Illustrissimi, ac Reuerendissimi Domini Ferdinandi Furstembergij Episcopi Pader-bornensis, & Sacri Romani Imperij Principis, cum humanitatis sparsæ suauitate, tum in-infignes amoris notis perferuntur, vnaque cum iis Disputatio Apologetica Hottingeri contra Leonem Allatium de consensu Orientalis, & Occidentalis Ecclesiarum perpetuo. Non est quod amplius dicam, actutum attento animo lectioni me dedi, neque intermisi, donec ad exitum Disputatio illa adducta est: Quid tum? Magnopere admiratus sum hominis infantiam putidam, audaciam inconsultam, temeritatem inverecundam, & vt verbo exple-

page.notes: Printed words are all transcribed. "vt" is normalised to "ut" in the text as per the u/v rule (it appears as "vt" in the last line; it is written as ut). Words broken at line ends keep their printed hyphen: "Pader-bornensis", "exple-" (continues on the next page), and "deprehen-" joined to "deprehenduntur". The line "tianæ" is a fragment at the page top and stays so. Long s is plain s throughout. No doubtful readings.
